literal: With the group having acted, not considering, the king, in anger having acted, if he rages, will shrink wealth.
translation: If a king fails to deliberate with his council of ministers and instead lashes out in blind anger, his wealth and prosperity will shrink.
modern: தன் அமைச்சர்களோடு சேர்ந்து ஆலோசிக்காமல், கோபத்திற்கு ஆளாகிச் சீறும் அரசனின் செல்வம் சுருங்கி அழியும்.
explanation: This couplet warns against the destructive combination of isolation and anger in a leader. The phrase 'இனத்து ஆற்றி எண்ணாத' describes a king who fails to deliberate with his council of ministers before acting. When such an isolated ruler gives way to anger ('சினத்து ஆற்றி') and lashes out, his poor judgment drives away support. Consequently, his wealth and prosperity ('திரு') will inevitably diminish ('சிறுகும்').
